try: YOLO question_no detector: grid of 7 runs (yolo11n/s, default/scan augmentation, lr 0.001/0.002/0.004, freeze 0/10), 40 epochs, patience 10
data: Roboflow answer sheets (8 booklets) split by booklet
result: best on validation: yolo11n, scan aug, lr 0.002 (val AP50 0.49); test AP50 0.79, precision 0.65, recall 0.78; yolo11s worse on this little data

try: YOLO text_line detector: grid of 4 runs (yolo11n/s; default/scan augmentation)
data: Roboflow handwritten line photos split by session
result: best on validation: yolo11n, default aug (val AP50 0.88); test AP50 0.88, precision 0.80, recall 0.84
decision: kept: finds the lines for the ocr mode

try: Baselines for the detectors: rules (no learning) and COCO YOLO11n zero-shot
result: rules AP50 0.00 (numbers) and 0.19 (lines); COCO zero-shot about 0
decision: training is needed for both detectors

try: Reader v1, modes rules and detectors (YOLO question_no + text_line, TrOCR base reads)
data: all 50 Mendeley exams (first and clean run)
result: questions found: detectors 10.9%, rules 13.6%; question_no's highest confidence on a Mendeley page was 0.006
decision: the question_no detector does not transfer from its single training source; redesign

try: Search for public datasets with handwritten question numbers (Roboflow Universe: Gazi University question boxes and four others; Hugging Face; IEEE DataPort)
data: web search; Gazi set downloaded and looked at
result: none usable: the Gazi set is printed Turkish test books; the others label whole regions, bubbles or nothing
decision: no new training data for question numbers

try: ocr mode, versions 1 to 4: line detector + TrOCR base, question number read from the start of the text, with sequence repair, mid-line split, widened or cut line boxes
data: 11 Mendeley exams used for development (broke the evaluation-only rule) and 39 held out
result: questions found on the 11: v1 13.5%, v2 20.7%, widen+cut 15.3%, cut only 25.6%; on the 39: 31.1%, MCQ letters right 15.7%
decision: superseded: every rule was re-decided on the development set (steps 11 to 14)
evidence: reads overwritten in the cache; numbers from the session log

try: Readers compared: TrOCR base, TrOCR large, Qwen3-VL-2B on the line crops, Qwen3-VL-2B on the whole page
result: questions found: 25.6%, 34.3%, 46.1%, 90.8%; the page reader invented about 40 numbers per exam on blank pages and after the last answer
decision: superseded by the same comparison on the development set (step 11)

try: Page reader safeguards tried on Mendeley: blank-page skip at 0.2% dark pixels, number-run filters, a line cap from the detector's line count (n+2, 1.5n+2, 2n+2), a periodic-loop filter (runs of 6 to 16)
result: line cap: invented numbers 16.5 -> 0.7 per exam but questions found 90% -> 76%; loop filter of 12: 87% found, 0.8 invented; on the 39 held out: 84.7% found
decision: superseded and removed: the 0.2% threshold would have skipped real light-pen pages of the development set

try: Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL on the Roboflow answer sheets
result: the set has boxes but no transcriptions and comes from one source (the source the question_no detector overfitted to)

try: Qwen3-VL-2B page reader on CPU (2 threads, as a free Hugging Face Space)
result: 85 s a page, 13.3 GB of memory at its peak (about 5 s a page on an Apple GPU)
decision: deployable on a free Space but slow; noted as a limit

try: Readers compared on the development set: TrOCR base and large on lines, Qwen3-VL-2B on lines, Qwen3-VL-2B and 4B on the whole page
data: 114 public images: SMHD pages, ASAP answers, Roboflow answer sheets, short and blank pages
result: character error on SMHD: 27.6%, 22.1%, 18.9%, 7.3% (2B page), 6.5% (4B page); numbers found at line starts: 23%, 30%, 56%, 89% (2B), 85% (4B); 4B twice as slow
decision: Qwen3-VL-2B on the whole page (4B: slightly better text but fewer numbers and too big for a free Space)

try: Decoding of the page reader: greedy, repetition_penalty 1.02 and 1.05; loop filters (consecutive duplicates, stop at the k-th repeat, the step 8 filter)
result: greedy invented 703 lines on short and blank pages; both penalties 12, error unchanged; stop-at-repeat cut real SMHD text (worst page error 28% -> 80%)

try: Question-number rules: stray-mark prefix, sequence repair, mid-line split, numbers with no separator
data: development set (SMHD numbered lines and answer sheets)
result: prefix: 89% of numbers found vs 84% without; the three others found no more numbers and added extra ones

try: Blank-page threshold, on an ink measure relative to the page's background (light pens count)

result: page (2B): 86.2% of questions found, 81.4% of MCQ letters right (98.9% when read), 4.5 numbers not in the key per exam; ocr 27.2%; detectors 10.9%; rules 13.6%
evidence: reader_eval_summary.csv; reads/mendeley_reads.csv (text kept locally: it holds names and IDs)

try: Frozen reader with Qwen3-VL-4B as the page reader (repetition_penalty 1.05, same rules)
data: all 50 Mendeley exams (read once; the choice of 2B was made on the development set before)
result: questions found 83.4% (2B: 86.2%), MCQ letters right 76.0% (2B: 81.4%), written answers found 85.8% (2B: 83.0%), 14.3 numbers not in the key per exam (2B: 4.5), 55 s per exam (2B: 18 s)
decision: confirms the development-set choice: 2B for the product

try: Development set extended with School Notebooks EN (MIT): 12 phone photos of English notebooks, 2 with numbered lists
result: page reader character error on notebooks: 2B 5.1%, 4B 4.0%, Qwen lines 31.9%, TrOCR large 45.3%, TrOCR base 50.9%; both list pages' numbers found by both page readers; every choice of steps 11 to 14 unchanged
decision: no change to the reader; Mendeley not read again

try: Fine-tuning data for the page reader: GNHK real pages plus synthetic exam pages (EMNIST numbers and A-D letters, OpenHand-Synth answer lines)
data: GNHK (CC BY 4.0), OpenHand-Synth (CC BY 4.0), EMNIST (CC BY 4.0); no Mendeley exam and no development-set image
result: 1,012 training pages (512 GNHK, 500 synthetic) and 261 validation pages (161 GNHK, 100 synthetic); no line shared with the development set; GNHK rotation tags and OpenHand grey backgrounds fixed after looking at the pages; 11 GNHK test pages that are second photos of training pages dropped from validation
decision: data ready; synthetic pages halved from 1,000 to 500 (already read almost perfectly, and the slowest to train)

try: LoRA training of Qwen3-VL-2B on the step 18 data (rank 16, language model only, one epoch, 8 pages per step)
result: first full run: memory grew to 57 GB on a 48 GB Mac (freed memory kept in the GPU cache), swapped and was stopped with nothing saved; after emptying the cache every page and capping memory at 70% of the GPU maximum, the 24 heaviest pages peak at 21.1 GB, 17 s a page
decision: run again with the fixes (about 4 hours); the adapter is judged on the development set
